g.text: Scoping draft • primary emphasis per paper • named categories, not scores
Read with the Markdown evidence and GNC matrices. Blank cells mean no selected example, not an established research gap.
Panel A includes simulations and purpose-matched surrogates, not only free-flying gimbal vehicles. Panel B does not establish TVC transfer.
Spannagl and Linsen also address mismatch; QuadRocket also addresses coupling and actuation. Primary placement is not exclusive.
